# Select

One choice from a list, in a menu.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Accessible first</span> A component joins only when it works with any assistive technology. The native select covers the same choice and every assistive technology understands it. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./native-select">Native select</a>, <a href="./radio-group">Radio group</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Four or more options, a known closed list, or a setting with a default.
- **Not when:** Two to five options people should see (radio group), or many flags (checkboxes).

Instead:

- [Radio group](./radio-group.md): A short list shown at once.
- [Combobox](./combobox.md): Type to find in a long list.
- [Native select](./native-select.md): The system picker.

## Words

- Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
- One idea per sentence. Put the action first.
- Never blame the person.
- Use: Continue, Change, Start, You. Avoid: Invalid, Utilise, Submit, Error code.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Continue
- `content.action.cancel`: Go back
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Start a new application

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Arrows move; Enter picks; Escape closes. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It has a visible label; the chosen value is announced. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add select
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Select reads 13 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. A row marked Themeable changes between light and dark. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Select's tokens to change Select alone.
